1. SCoPe -Covers the requirements for thin-walled half flanged bearings suitable having inside diameter of 38 to 150 mm. A reference has also been made constructional features generally associated with manufacturing techniques.
2. Terminology-For the purpose of this standard, definitions and classifications of plain bearings: and Part III Lubrication, shall apply. 3. Material 3.1 Thecompositions of lining materials and steel backing generally flanged bearings shall be as given in Appendix A and B respectively. be checked from each lot for chemical composition and microstructure.

the definitions given in IS : 10260-1982 I Terms, Part I Construction, Part II Friction and wear;

used for th"e manufacture of At least one sample shall

and firmly bonded to 3.2 Adherence Test - In order to ensure that the bearing metal is completely the back,ing metal, the adherence test shall be carried out. For conducting this test, unless specified otherwise by the purchaser, at least one bearing shall be taken from each lot of 500 pieces or less, The test shall be carried out as given in 3.2.1. 3.2.1 The grooves in the bearing-metal liner parallel to the longitudinal axis of the bearing shall be cut with a chisel. The grooves shall be the full depth of the bearing.metal liner and shall be spaced so as to leave lands of bearing metal approximately 6 mm wide. The chisel shall than be inserted at right angles to the bearing metal lands at the bond line and the liner cut away along the bond line. This operation shall be repeated at intervals along the lands to determine if there is any tendency for the lining to separate cleanly and as a unit from the backing metal. The inside surface of the backing metal shall be examined and any evidence of poor bonding shall be a cause for the rejection of the lot represented. 3.3 Microstructure material. 4. Dimensions 5. Tolerances 5.1 Housing Diameter-Ferrous housing shall be manufactured to H6 limits [see IS : 919 ( Part I )1963 Recommendations for limits and fits for engineering: Part I General engineering (first revision)], but in the case of housings made from materials having a high coefficient of expansion, or where other factors such as housing dimensional stability are involved, the housing size may depart from H6 limits but shall always be produced in accordance with a grade 6 tolerance. 5.2 Peripheral Length ( Crush ) -The method given in 5.6. peripheral length shall be measured by use of the checking Microstructure shall be checked shall to ensure that there Table is no 1. flaw in bearing

EXPLANATORY

NOTE

This standard was earlier published by Rolling Bearing Sectional Committee, EDC 39. Consequently, on the setting up of Plain Bearing Sectional Committee, EDC 80, this subject was committee felt transferred from EDC 39 to EDC 80. At the time of periodic review, the concerned the need of revising the specification in line with current international practice. This specification covers flange bearings. has been divided in two parts. Part I covers bimetallic plain bearings and Part.11 to

The flange half liners which are formed from pressed housing inside diameters from 38 mm to 150 mm.

strips

are generally&limited

-Flange bearings manufactured by pressing or New Developments in Flange Construction casting, have integral flanges and as such, they have same bearing alloy for bearing bore and thrust face. With new manufacturing techniques developed recently, it is possible to manufacture flange The following bearings by attaching thrust washers at both or either end of plain journal bearing. two types of flange bearing construction are recently in use. a) Clip-on Flanges - Plain journal bearing and half thrust washers are provided lugs respectively and these are interference fitted into each other to form flanged Fig. 14 illustrates typical construction of clip-on type flange designs. This b) diameter together thickness mounted design gives flexibility of using dissimilar bearing alloy for flange thrust with slots and bearing. The

faces.

Interference Fitted Flanges - In this design of flange bearing, the thrust washer internal is kept interference fit on plain journal bearing outside diameter and these two are pressed However, this design is limited to applications where plain bearing to form flange bearing. is appreciably to provide necessary rigidity for interference fit of thrust washer to be on to it. 14
